issues.claim: Zenith Energy — 1 Highland Ave, Metuchen; category 'energy consulting'; website http://www.zenithem.com/
issues.problem: zenithem.com is the corporate site of Zenith Energy L.P., a Houston-headquartered bulk liquid storage terminal operator (3900 Essex Lane, Houston per its LinkedIn profile; own site describes 7 terminals in 5 states). D&B names the Metuchen record 'Zenith Energy Management, LLC'. So the local listing is a secondary/registered office of a multi-site corporate group, not an independent Metuchen energy consultancy, and 'energy consulting' is an inference not stated anywhere I opened.
issues.fix: Reclassify or drop: treat as a corporate affiliate (chain-type exclusion) unless the local entity is confirmed to be independent and client-facing; if kept, relabel the category as 'liquid storage / energy holding company (affiliate)' and note the Houston parent.

issues.claim: Management Recruiters of Edison — 276 Main St, 2nd Floor (recruiting and staffing)
